summary: Frontend UI testing (desktop 1440x900) of Yulia Kitchen POS new features: Diskon Transaksi and Menu Andalan. Logged in as owner, verified bestseller sort/badges, nominal + percent discount recalculation, cash checkout with discount in receipt, regression without discount, and Produk bestseller toggle persistence.

issues: Radix Dialog accessibility warnings in console: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby'. Non-blocking but should be fixed with VisuallyHidden DialogTitle for accessibility compliance.

action_items: (optional) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle or aria-describedby to PaymentModal and product option modals to silence Radix a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Kasir.jsx discountAmount clamps values (0..subtotal for amount, 0..100 for percent) which is correct.
CartPanel only shows discount line when discountAmount>0 - clean UI behavior verified.
ReceiptView and buildReceiptText both include Diskon line when txn.discount_amount>0 - consistent.
Kasir sort places bestsellers first then alphabetical - verified with 4 bestsellers at top.
seed_data_creation: None. Toggled Paket Hemat Nasi + Es Teh to bestseller during test (persisted). Also created 1 completed transaction (TRX2608240003) with 10% discount.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested flows pass. Bestseller sort correct: Es Kelapa Muda, Es Teh Manis, Mojito Lemon, Mojito Strawberry appear as top 4 with badges. Nominal Rp5000 on Rp22000 -> Rp17000. Percent 10% on Rp22000 -> discount Rp2200 (labeled '(10%)') -> total Rp19800. Cash payment via 'Uang Pas' confirmed; success screen (Pembayaran Berhasil) shows receipt with 'Diskon -Rp2.200' line. Regression: after 'Pesanan Baru', cart with only Paket Hemat shows Total=Rp22.000, no discount line. Produk bestseller switch (data-testid product-bestseller) toggles unchecked->checked, save-product persists, list shows extra 'Best Seller' label (5 total after adding Paket Hemat).
